'''kpimenatl Hidden Base''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[kpimenatl]]
* '''Published:''' 28 March 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS1]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Home One: War Room|DS2-L-homeonewarroom.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Home One: War Room
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS1 Home One War Room kpimenatl LS.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

I like to use a lot of space with systems you can Force Drain!!!! With a couple of good ground guys.

The published list has 58 cards.

== Strategy ==

To use this deck you have to quickly get your ships and pilots out. That's why I have squadron assignments and get to your ship.

I have several systems where you can force drain for 2 or more. I like that because you can waste your partner with force drains.

I have a couple of cards that if set up right you can take out the executor. We all know how pesky that ship is.

I put a couple of ground pounders in there so you can make some battle damage on the ground.

Over all the deck has done pretty well.
